## Changes: * #1300: completions-core: fix: upgrade to latest commit to fix build * #1297: Determine cell and position of NES suggestion * #1257: Migrate to @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk * #1298: Revert "Migrate to @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk (#1257)" * #1291: chore: update model capabilities * #1290: remove initial launch config * #1289: Move hydrate resolve model into a common place * #1288: simulator: use Copilot Chat Token * #1287: Set VITEST as a workaround until we can change the cache code * #1283: tools: use a binary format for local tool embedding cache
See More * #1262: Add BYOK API key management command * #1282: tools: cache virtual tools embeddings locally * #1281: Update completions core version * #1279: Work on bringing more tests back to completions core * #1258: Fix missing text after code blocks and missing code blocks, in @vscode responses * #1277: Bolster 403 error messages to prove it's proxy * #1275: Fix editing from executePrompt tool * #1276: Bump engines version * #1273: nes: change team default model * #1272: Add launch-config that allows to attach to code-oss (started out of the `vscode`) * #1231: feat: add custom `requestHeaders` support for custom OAI and Azure models in BYOK * #1266: Don't block extension activation on auth * #1265: Add associatedRequestId to track summarization chat request id * #1264: nes: next cursor line: add telemetry * #1260: Enable useResponsesAPI by default * #1263: nes: next cursor line: fix: infinite no-edit loop & aligning better with training data prompt * #1250: testing: static Copilot Token loading * #1247: get errors for a notebook URI * #1233: feat: add timeout in searching text in files * #1157: Add security-sensitive file extensions to workspace indexing exclusion list * #1248: Update telemetry in CreateFileTool to include model and file extension details * #1192: Update fetch tool to use metis * #1255: Update repo URL in @vscode/chat-lib package * #1254: Cleaup old exp * #1253: Exclude completions core tests * #1252: Update CHANGELOG for v0.32 * #1238: nes: feat: support next cursor line prediction * #1249: Git - switch commit message generation to gpt5-mini * #1245: Exp enable completions and NES fetcher * #1246: Update sonnet-4.5 alt prompt * #1241: nes: refactor prompt construction for extensibility * #1232: feat: Hide editFile tool message * #1236: Remove auto mode enablement exp * #1228: Retry net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED with Node * #1229: Retry net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED with Node * #1230: Fix excessive content exclusion fetches * #1073: Improve error handling for Copilot Chat when 404 * #1227: Version bump This list of changes was [auto generated](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/Monaco/_build/results?buildId=363986&view=logs).
